;
;1. If no health factors were selected, quit.
;2. Get selection from the VALM array.
;3. Initialize variables.
;4. Get new selection from the VALM array.
;5. Loop through each selected entry:
;  a. Parse the selection into DA (IEN of 393.3).
;  b. Set up variables for editing (DGJTEDT, DGJDFNO, IFN).
;  c. Call editing routines (EDIT1, ABB, RSET).
;  d. If entry was deleted, set DGJFLAG.
